entries.title: Proverbs 12:1
segments: Whoso loveth correction loveth knowledge; But he that hateth reproof is brutish.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:2
segments: A good man shall obtain favor of Jehovah; But a man of wicked devices will he condemn.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:3
segments: A man shall not be established by wickedness; But the root of the righteous shall not be moved.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:4
segments: A worthy woman is the crown of her husband; But she that maketh ashamed is as rottenness in his bones.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:5
segments: The thoughts of the righteous are just; [But] the counsels of the wicked are deceit.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:6
segments: The words of the wicked are of lying in wait for blood; But the mouth of the upright shall deliver them.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:7
segments: The wicked are overthrown, and are not; But the house of the righteous shall stand.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:8
segments: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom; But he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:9
segments: Better is he that is lightly esteemed, and hath a servant, Than he that honoreth himself, and lacketh bread.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:10
segments: A righteous man regardeth the life of his beast; But the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:11
segments: He that tilleth his land shall have plenty of bread; But he that followeth after vain [persons] is void of understanding.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:12
segments: The wicked desireth the net of evil men; But the root of the righteous yieldeth [fruit].

entries.title: Proverbs 12:13
segments: In the transgression of the lips is a snare to the evil man; But the righteous shall come out of trouble.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:14
segments: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth; And the doings of a man's hands shall be rendered unto him.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:15
segments: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes; But he that is wise hearkeneth unto counsel.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:16
segments: A fool's vexation is presently known; But a prudent man concealeth shame.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:17
segments: He that uttereth truth showeth forth righteousness; But a false witness, deceit.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:18
segments: There is that speaketh rashly like the piercings of a sword; But the tongue of the wise is health.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:19
segments: The lip of truth shall be established for ever; But a lying tongue is but for a moment.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:20
segments: Deceit is in the heart of them that devise evil; But to the counsellors of peace is joy.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:21
segments: There shall no mischief happen to the righteous; But the wicked shall be filled with evil.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:22
segments: Lying lips are an abomination to Jehovah; But they that deal truly are his delight.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:23
segments: A prudent man concealeth knowledge; But the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:24
segments: The hand of the diligent shall bear rule; But the slothful shall be put under taskwork.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:25
segments: Heaviness in the heart of a man maketh it stoop; But a good word maketh it glad.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:26
segments: The righteous is a guide to his neighbor; But the way of the wicked causeth them to err.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:27
segments: The slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting; But the precious substance of men [is to] the diligent.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:28
segments: In the way of righteousness is life; And in the pathway thereof there is no death.
